# Sachin Hebbale

> Sachin Kallappa Hebbale is an AI Engineer and freelance web & AI developer based in Belagavi, Karnataka, India. He builds websites and AI chatbots for photographers, studios and local businesses, working with clients in Belagavi, Hubballi-Dharwad and across India.

## Facts
- Full name: Sachin Kallappa Hebbale (goes by Sachin Hebbale)
- Location: Belagavi, Karnataka, India
- Role: AI Engineer at Teamium.io; freelance website and AI chatbot developer
- Previous: Computer Vision Engineer Intern at PIVAGA; AI Intern at Vinidra Softech
- Education: B.E. Computer Engineering, Visvesvaraya Technological University (2022-2026)
- Research: published work on a voice-based banking assistant for people who cannot read
- Skills: Python, SQL, JavaScript, Java, LLMs, RAG, semantic search (pgvector), Gemini, OpenCV, Firebase, MongoDB

## Services
- Business websites: mobile-first sites with WhatsApp and call buttons, basic SEO, hosting and launch handled
- AI chatbots: website or WhatsApp assistants that answer from a business's own FAQs and prices and pass leads to the owner
- AI automation and smart search for teams and startups
- SEO, local SEO (Google Maps / "near me"), GEO (visibility in ChatGPT and AI answers) and AEO (FAQ answers Google can show) for client websites
- Blog posts and FAQ content written for client websites
- Logo animation: cinematic logo reveals and intros for production houses, studios and brands
